description: A feature line that disappears from a marketing page is 'no longer listed', not discontinued, when a product page for it still exists.
source: Audit: page removal read as discontinuation. Green after phase 3 (prompt rule).

mustInclude.statementMatches: start page[^.]*(no longer (listed|mentioned|appears|featured)|removed from the agency page|dropped from the page)

mustNotInclude.statementMatches: start page[^.]*(discontinued|shut down|sunset|removed the product|killed|retired the product|no longer (offered|available))
